Quem somos nós?

A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de chá e café. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar grande impacto.

Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.

Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.

A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Nosso propósito é transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!

Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.

Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa.   • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com desenvolvedores, analistas de requisitos e líderes, apoiando na solução de problemas e eliminando inconformidades;
  • Documentar e informar de forma clara e específica sobre produtos e serviços não conformes nos softwares de gestão dos projetos, combatendo reincidências.

  • 1/2 anos de experiência em função semelhante, de preferência em FMCG ou varejo.

  • Mentalidade analítica com capacidade de interpretar dados e traduzi-los em insights acionáveis.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e precisão no gerenciamento de sistemas operacionais, relatórios e processos de conformidade.
  • Compreensão básica dos princípios de marketing e estratégias de ativação.
  • Fortes habilidades técnicas no Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) e familiaridade com ferramentas digitais como o Buzzmonitor.

Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar atividades de manutenção relativas à serralheria e soldas em geral, bem como auxiliar demais membros da equipe quando necessário.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.
As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

CONTEXTO / DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

No âmbito da parceria com a Enel Distribuição São Paulo e Ceará, a AVSI Brasil atuará a partir de 2025 na execução e formatação sistemática do PROGRAMA ECOENEL - Troca de resíduos por bônus na conta de energia. Missão do cargo

Responsável pela operação de equipamentos industriais da área de processos em mais de duas subáreas, visando entregar o volume de produção planejado, seguindo todos os procedimentos operacionais da área, garantindo seus requisitos de segurança e qualidade, com menor custo e evitando desperdício.

Cumprir e fazer cumprir as disposições legais e regulamentares sobre segurança e saúde no trabalho.

Cumprir com as regras que salvam vidas.

Usar o equipamento de proteção individual fornecido pelo empregador.

Principais atribuições

  1. Executar a operação dos equipamentos desde o recebimento de matérias primas e insumos produtivos até a liberação do produto para o envasamento, bem como as operações de limpeza em equipamentos (CIP – Limpeza e Sanitização) de forma a garantir o atendimento aos volumes de produção dentro dos padrões de segurança e qualidade e sistemas de gestão estabelecidos;

  5. Contribuir com a governança da área, através da participação em reuniões e troca de turno;
  6. Contribuir com a melhoria de seu local de trabalho através da participação em times de TPM;

  8. Realizar pequenas manutenções e melhorias na área;
  9. Auxiliar o analista industrial nos controles administrativos, através do preenchimento de controles de produção, registros e sistemas informatizados, de forma a garantir o controle de inventários, custos, consumo e produtividade. Está precisando de apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica ou financeira? Temos o programa ‘Conta Comigo’ com profissionais especializados para te atender 24 horas por dia.

E para desenvolver ainda mais a nossa liderança temos o programa 'Be Leader'* – um programa interno exclusivo que acontece anualmente para fomentar o aprendizado e a conexão do nosso time de Líderes.

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. description:
Join to apply for the Tax Coordinator role at Unilever

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you love fast-paced environments, are passionate about helping others, and like the sounds of acting as an orchestrator where your impacts will be felt throughout multiple countries then this role is just for you!

Business Context: Direct Taxes are the taxes levied on profit, from here the employee will:

  • manage direct taxes in a collaborative environment;
  • interact with other areas of the group (finance, marketing, sales);
  • be introduced to company´s businesses;
  • work for and with the decision makers.

Main Purpose

Support the company on the management and reporting of direct taxes, ensuring compliance, optimizing cash flow, and being aware of the company´s profitability. These efforts contribute to the Group's Sustainable Living Plan Goal.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Calculate and report direct taxes (IRPJ and CSLL), including current, deferred, and contingent taxes, as well as taxes on cross-border transactions (royalties, cost sharing, dividends, interest, CIDE, IOF, etc);
  • Understand Gaap Differences such as Brazil Gaap, IFRS, USGAAP;
  • Perform Transfer Pricing calculations;
  • Obtain and maintain tax incentives (e.g., Lucro da Exploração, Inovação Tecnológica, Lei Rouanet);
  • Review and supervise calculations, payments, and tax returns;
  • Manage tax contingencies and exposures;
  • Analyze and interpret direct tax law;
  • Engage in direct tax planning (M&A, new business models, etc);
  • Forecast direct tax outcomes;
  • Calculate Effective Tax Rate (ETR);
  • Prepare and present tax reports locally and globally;
  • Partner with other areas for consultancy;
  • Participate in tax audits (internal and external);
  • Handle tax inspections by authorities.

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Experience in Corporate Income Taxes (IRPJ and CSLL) and remittances;
  • Proficiency in English (writing, reading, speaking);
  • Knowledge of Tax and Accounting principles.

Desirable Skills

  • Power BI;
  • Automation and tax transformation;
  • Data analysis skills.

Skills

  • Time management;
  • Decision making;
  • Growth mindset;
  • Collaboration and teamwork;
  • Positivity;
  • Creative thinking;
  • Conflict resolution;
  • Motivation;
  • Openness to innovation.

Leadership

  • Deliver results with enthusiasm;
  • Lead by example in results and resilience;
  • Seek continuous improvement and collaborate;
  • Own your wellbeing and work standards;
  • Be humble, data-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life. We are committed to equity, inclusion, and diversity to drive our results and create a better future. We want everyone to bring their ‘Whole Self’ to work. If you need support or accommodations, please inform us during your application process.

VENHA SER UM COORDENADOR DE CURSO NA ESTÁCIO.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os seus principais desafios como Coordenador de Curso são:

  • Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a solidificação da nossa marca.

Deve, também, supervisionar as atividades de pesquisa, se existirem, assim como as atividades de nivelamento.

  • Ter registro no conselho de Classe ativo e regular;

  • Capacidade de comunicação expositiva e precisa do tema;

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

title: Especialista estrategia de credito
description:
Um dos principais desafios que a Superlógica tem para o futuro é aumentar a oferta de crédito para seus clientes.

Neste cenário, a área de crédito terá um papel fundamental nesta agenda de crescimento, e estamos buscando pessoas que queiram fazer a diferença conosco!

A área de estratégia de crédito funciona como o coração do negócio. Aqui, definimos as políticas de crédito, que são regras e critérios que serão analisados para que nossos clientes tenham acesso aos nossos produtos. Para definir tais políticas, são realizados diversos estudos, baseados em dados e fatos, para tomarmos as melhores decisões.

Por isso, buscamos uma pessoa que tenha bastante viés analítico e que saiba dominar ferramentas de análise; que seja capaz de traduzir suas entregas e da equipe em números de negócio; que tenha igual atenção a pequenos detalhes e ao negócio como um todo; e saber criar parcerias duradouras com as demais equipes da companhia.

Se interessou? Venha ajudar a gente a criar experiências incríveis!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Cultura: Adotar, promover e difundir a cultura da Superlógica, fomentando valores e princípios em todas as práticas e interações;
  • Desenvolver, manter e atualizar as políticas de crédito e preços da Superlógica, buscando otimizar a relação risco-retorno e atender ao apetite de risco estabelecido pela companhia.
  • Construir modelos preditivos e realizar análises baseadas em dados, dominando as principais ferramentas de mercado.
  • Analisar e projetar indicadores sobre a performance e rentabilidade da carteira de crédito, de modo a antecipar tendências e saber traduzir seus achados em planos de ação concretos nas políticas.
  • Interagir e comunicar-se com as diversas áreas da companhia e diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de maneira assertiva e proativa, dando nitidez sobre oportunidades, problemas e planos de ação.
  • Traduzir direcionamentos estratégicos da companhia para atividades no plano tático, elencando prioridades de acordo com potencial de ganho versus esforço.
  • Exercer papel de liderança técnica para os demais membros do time, tanto na disseminação de conhecimento sobre as ferramentas de análise, quanto na orientação, apoio e validação de estudos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Engenharias, Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em análise de dados, com experiência avançada em Excel e linguagens de programação (R, Python, SQL, etc.);
  • Tenha conhecimentos sobre o ciclo de crédito, com experiência em áreas de estratégia de crédito, gestão de portfólio, estratégia de cobrança e/ou finanças voltadas para produtos de crédito;
  • Possua uma visão analítica, capaz de traduzir atividades diárias em métricas e indicadores de negócio;
  • Apresenta boa comunicação oral e escrita, de modo a conseguir traduzir seus projetos e atividades para os diferentes níveis hierárquicos da companhia;
  • Construa relacionamentos sólidos e inspiradores, capazes de influenciar e engajar não apenas os liderados, mas também colegas e liderança;
  • Seja proativo(a) e crítico(a), pronto(a) para mergulhar de cabeça na resolução de problemas e sem medo de botar a mão na massa;
  • Apresente uma curiosidade inata, buscando compreender minuciosamente os processos e sua interconexão no contexto macro da companhia.

Nosso propósito é descomplicar a relação das pessoas com suas casas, condomínios e vizinhança.

title: CONTROLLING SPECIALIST
description:
Job Description

This role is responsible for regional HR controlling and reporting, encompassing budget management, financial analysis, and ensuring compliance. The specialist will lead regional budgetary processes, consolidate financial data, and provide insights to HR Business Partners. Additionally, this role supports regional HR budgeting, reporting, and data management, acting as a service function to provide financial status and analysis to stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

I. Regional HR Controlling & Process Unification:

Lead and manage the regional budget and budgetary control processes, ensuring alignment with Finance and Group HR controlling teams.

Perform regional consolidation and in-depth analysis of HR-related budget and month-end financial processes, including tracking plan-actual deviations and key HR performance indicators (KPIs).

Ensure consistent implementation of Group HR policies, standards, and tools across the region, driving the adoption of relevant initiatives.

Cultivate a strong partnership with Finance to maintain regional alignment and consistency in financial HR operations.

Monitor, analyze, and report on regional Headcount, Employment cost, and HR Costs variances, identifying key trends and potential risks.

Oversee cost management activities, including budget tracking, valuation of work completion, and supplier payment oversight, escalating significant variances.

Evaluate costs to identify variances and opportunities for enhanced profitability within HR operations.

Ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and relevant regulatory and ethical codes.

II. HR Budgeting, Reporting & Business Partner Support (Service Function):

Develop and manage the annual regional budgets for Headcount, Employment cost, and HR Costs, collaborating closely with Management, local HR teams, and Finance. This includes detailed cost calculations and insightful analysis.

Support the regional financial month-end closing process by providing necessary HR-related accounting adjustments and accruals. Prepare comprehensive monthly financial reports and analyses on Headcount, Employment cost, and HR Costs variances against the budget, identifying key drivers and changes in personnel expenses.

Serve as a key service function by delivering regular monthly status updates and actionable insights on regional HR budget performance, critical metrics, and HR KPI analysis to relevant stakeholders across the organization.

Manage regional HR data collection, reporting, and monitoring, ensuring data integrity and accuracy within relevant systems to facilitate reliable budgeting and reporting. This includes data collation and analysis using established tools and formats.

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and automated reports (potentially leveraging Excel, SAP, Power BI) to streamline budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes, improving efficiency and delivering valuable insights.

Contribute to regional cost management efforts by diligently tracking budgets, accurately valuing completed work, and providing essential data for supplier payments related to HR.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Business Administration.

Proven experience in accounting, controlling, and reporting, with a strong foundational understanding of accounting principles.

Advanced proficiency in Excel with exceptional analytical capabilities.

Fluency in English (both written and spoken).

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical with strong analytical skills.

Effective team player capable of achieving objectives under pressure and tight deadlines.

Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and professional standards.

Payroll experience is advantageous.

Familiarity with SAP and Power BI is a plus.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Job Overview
Direct and manage the execution of the strategic, operational and financial delivery of required Site Activation activities, including but not limited to Site ID and Selection, Ethics and Regulatory processes and Site Contracting for assigned studies as determined by Company, scope of work and/or sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions

  1. Provides strategic planning and project oversight accelerating Site Activation through best in class project management to ensure fast site activation for patient enrollment; responsibilities may include being accountable for multiple regions.
  2. Support and/or participate in pre-award/bid defense activities.
  3. Oversee the execution of Start Up (including pre-award through Site Activation) and/or Lifecycle Maintenance for assigned projects in accordance with the agreed start up strategy, adhering to agreed project timelines and in compliance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonization (ICH)-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol, customer requirements, and internal policies).
  4. Study Delivery Scope minimum expectations: accountable for multiple regions or Global SAM project oversight responsibilities.
  5. Develop, implement and maintain the Site Activation Management Plan according to the Scope of Work and Project Plan, within the agreed project strategy, resolving project related issues where required.
  6. Collaborate with key stakeholders both internal and external, through effective communication and resolution management, including communication with regions and countries, to successfully deliver the agreed project scope in compliance with the Site Activation Management Plan.
  7. Execute operational strategy/expectations for maintenance of clinical study approvals, authorizations and review/negotiation of contracts and essential documents.
  8. Assess and review the regulatory landscape and contribute to the collection, interpretation, analysis and dissemination of accurate regulatory intelligence to support assigned studies and wider company, as required.
  9. Determine regulatory strategy/expectations and parameters for submissions and all necessary authorizations. Identify regulatory complexity and challenges and offer creative and practical solutions to support the bid process and subsequent execution of the Site Activation Management Plan.
  10. Provide ongoing updates and reporting to various levels of the organization, both study team and in some cases senior level colleagues.
  11. Ensure accurate completion and maintenance of internal systems, databases, tracking tools, timelines and project plans with project specific information.
  12. Create and/or review technical and administrative documentation to support business development and enable study initiation and maintenance, as required.
  13. Adhere to quality standards, regulated and Company specific through the duration of the trial period.
  14. Mentor and coach colleagues as required: mentor to Grade 140.
  15. May take a lead role in developing long standing relationships with preferred IQVIA customers: Maintain and develop the customer relationship through study teamwork and support providing input to customer level processes and/or initiatives, attend Early Engagement Customer or Partnership Meetings if required.
  16. Deliver presentations/training to clients, colleagues and professional bodies, as required.
  17. Contribute to initiatives that affect positive change within the department and organization: support department and organizational initiatives.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's Degree in Life sciences or related field (Required)
  2. At least 5 years with 2 years of lead experience in a scientific or clinical environment (Required)
  3. Demonstrable experience in an international role; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience (Required)

A SPAR chegou ao Brasil em 2016 e hoje já soma mais de 7 mil SPARtanos presentes nos pontos de venda, nos mais diversos canais em todo o território nacional.

Somos uma organização orientada para resultados. Nosso compromisso com a excelência vem de nossas pessoas e de nossa cultura organizacional. Sabemos que atrair, apoiar e incentivar nosso pessoal é o que faz a diferença e o que gera os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. title: Art Director Sr.
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

As a Senior Art Director for one of the largest automotive companies in the world, you'll partner with copywriters, account managers, creative directors, strategists, and other creatives to deliver a variety of compelling materials. A fast and flexible go-getter, you thrive on new opportunities and possess a natural aptitude for collaboration. You maintain exceptionally high standards, elevating the craft of design and art direction, inspiring both yourself and your team to achieve impactful results. You excel at crafting visually engaging, strategically-informed, and pixel-perfect designs across the account. Comfortable working both hands-on and delegating to junior and production designers, you also excel at providing clear, concise feedback to colleagues. You bring a progressive creative instinct and positivity, working effectively in teams with a low-ego approach.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the creative process from concept ideation to production, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and innovative work across all deliverables.
  • Critique major deliverables, upholding the highest standards of creative excellence and ensuring alignment with client objectives.
  • Confidently present work alongside Creative Directors during client reviews, effectively communicating creative vision and elevating brand expression.
  • Cultivate strong client relationships, actively listening to and understanding their vision, objectives, and feedback.
  • Embrace a hands-on approach, seamlessly collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive projects forward and proactively identify areas for improvement.
  • Guide the conceptual and aesthetic direction of campaigns, asset creation, experiential activations, and design projects.
  • Drive innovation and creativity, setting new industry standards and ensuring work is consistently smart, impactful, and scalable.
  • Thrive in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment, effectively prioritizing tasks and maintaining a poised and professional demeanor.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across time zones with a global team, supporting both local and international initiatives.
  • Partner with designers, animators, and other creatives to develop engaging content across multiple formats, including videos, static posts, and animations.
  • Demonstrate a genuine commitment to the well-being of Monks' culture, its people, and its clients.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of design and art direction experience in advertising and marketing.
  • Thrive under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and consistently meet tight deadlines.
  • Collaborate effectively with creative leads and copywriters, developing on-brand, strategically sound designs that meet brief requirements.
  • Present work with compelling rationale, demonstrating poise, professionalism, and clear communication skills, particularly when interacting with senior leaders and clients.
  • Combine creative and analytical thinking, asking insightful questions and critically assessing ideas from a conceptual standpoint.
  • Experience crafting brand style guides to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Contribute constructively to strategic and creative discussions throughout the entire project lifecycle, from conception to production.
  • Experience in the automotive and/or production industries is highly desired.
  • A versatile, contemporary, digital-centric portfolio showcasing a proven track record of excellence across multiple formats (digital, video, social, etc.) is required.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard design and collaboration software, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and Slack.

Your Work Style:

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented and organized, with an unwavering commitment to pixel-perfect precision.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and adaptable, thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Adept at handling quick turnarounds effectively as part of a dedicated, collaborative team.
  • Constructive, solution-oriented, and client-centric, balancing a strong work ethic with a positive, enjoyable approach.
  • Manage projects efficiently, minimizing friction and maximizing productivity.
  • Open to feedback, providing clear rationale and readily offering alternative solutions. Seamlessly transition between projects and brands.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Driven to become a subject matter expert with a strong understanding of related creative disciplines.
  • Possess excellent problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a proactive approach to delivering high-quality work on time.
  • Stay ahead of the curve with a finger on the pulse of emerging creative trends, cultures, and technologies.
  • Committed to upholding equity, inclusion, and accessibility in all aspects of the role.

Working Conditions:

  • The role may involve long hours and tight deadlines, requiring flexibility and a commitment to maintaining high standards under pressure. Collaboration with teams across different locations and time zones is frequently necessary.

About Monks

Monks is the global, purely digital, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global marketing and technology services to accelerate business possibilities and redefine how brands and businesses interact with the world.

IT Product Lead - Salesforce Integration

Apply locations: São Paulo, São Paulo, Brasil   |   Time type: Full time   |   Posted on: Posted Yesterday   |   Job requisition id: 240940W

Who are we, and what do we do?

At Corteva Agriscience , you will help us grow what’s next. No matter your role, you will be part of a team that is building the future of agriculture – leading breakthroughs in the innovation and application of science and technology that will better the lives of people all over the world and fuel the progress of humankind.

Corteva Agriscience is looking for an innovative, energetic, and transformational IT Product Lead for Salesforce Integration .

The Salesforce Integration IT Product Lead provides product consultation to Corteva’s Agile Product teams through collaboration with both business and technology stakeholders, leading the integration of the enterprise Salesforce platform with other platforms.

IT Product Leads are directly responsible for helping the business achieve their goals by serving as a critical role in the Product Development Process, bridging business strategy, process, and technology execution.

Primary Responsibilities - What you will do to help us grow!

  1. Lead the integration of the enterprise Salesforce platform with external systems like SAP/ERP, Eloqua, data warehouse, custom applications, etc.
  2. Collaborate with Business stakeholders, Platform Architect, Software Engineers, and Global Product Owners to inform and align on requirements.
  3. Analyze information from source/target systems with Salesforce objects/fields, and collaborate to confirm mappings, transformations, and additional data fields if needed.
  4. Lead mapping and requirements discussions with the business to confirm data being integrated and address additional logic for integration.
  5. Coordinate the execution of integration scope, schedule, dependencies, and cross-collaboration within IT and business units. Maintain transparency in reporting status, progress, challenges, and solutions.
  6. Create and maintain mapping documents to support the integration processes.
  7. Collaborate with software engineers during integration development and support.
  8. Coordinate and lead user acceptance testing with the business to ensure integrations are functioning correctly.
  9. Own the product roadmap for Salesforce integration.
  10. Facilitate defining a rolling roadmap for multiple years along with OKRs and KPIs.
  11. Lead quarterly planning and business review sessions.
  12. Create user stories for desired solution functionalities.
  13. Collaborate with IT Infrastructure & Operations to define release plans.

What expertise have you grown - What you bring to the table!

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field is desired.

Experience

  • 5+ years of Salesforce integration experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce web and mobile capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce Administration, VisualForce, Lightning Components, Salesforce APIs, APEX, Force.com, and AppExchange.
  • Previous experience with Azure Service Bus and Azure DevOps is preferred.
  • Experience applying User Experience (UX) and User Interaction (UI) best practices in website and mobile application design is a plus.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Ability to view ambiguity as an opportunity to define and drive business evolution.
  • Strong skills in structuring large amounts of complex information within a process framework.
  • Excellent communication skills, primarily conducting business in English with global, multicultural, and geographically dispersed teams.

description:
About us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.


What you'll do

We are looking for a Pre-Sales and Product Engineer to play a pivotal role in growing and supporting our Brazil wholesale, enterprise and government business. The ideal candidate will be upbeat, have the ability to communicate effectively, and have a proven background in understanding customer requirements and turning those requirements into fully defined and operational solutions, as well as providing advice for solution improvement and customer success. This is a hybrid role; 3 days a week are required in the Sao Paulo office, 2 days working remotely.


The day-to-day

  • Design end-to-end technical and commercial solutions, including relationships with external and internal suppliers seeking for best solutions
  • Deliver articulate and compelling value propositions around Viasat products and services
  • Carefully listen and understand customer needs and explain how our offerings can address those needs
  • Establish relationships with key technical, operations, marketing, product management, and program delivery stakeholders within our clients
  • Identify new opportunities for growth and propose solutions
  • Own the customer engagement - driving the requirement gathering and scoping process and leading customer solution workshops
  • Present a persuasive business case, sound technical arguments, and a clear value proposition
  • Respond to the technical elements of RFI/RFP/RFQs
  • Conduct trials, pilots, and homologation of 3rd party and Viasat solutions with customers
  • Deliver Customer Demonstrations, Technical Presentations, Proposal Documents, Workshops, and Training
  • Provide support on contract development and negotiation
  • Be the technical focal point for customers inquiries and owner of solution implementation

What you'll need

  • BA or BS degree in Electrical or Telecommunications Engineer or related field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)
  • A minimum of 5 years of technical pre-sales or related experience in the telecommunication satellite enterprise/wholesale/internet service provider markets
  • Experience in technical and commercial proposal elaboration, RFI/RFP responses
  • Experience in end-to-end solution homologation and implementation support
  • Technical background in WAN and LAN solutions (VPN, MPLS, QoS, Internet Access, WiFi solution)
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences, anticipate potential objections and persuade others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view and enable the decision making process
  • Careful attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and disciplined follow-up with customers
  • Advanced in oral and written skills, in both, English and Portuguese
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High tolerance for changes
  • High level of accountability
  • A willingness to travel given the location of our client base. This should cap out at no more than 30%

What will help you on the job

  • Desirable working experience within Brazilian carriers / telecom operators
  • Experience with satellite solutions (Vsat)
  • Experience in product management/owner/launch
  • Experience with Data Analytics (Tableau) and Python
  • Rigorous focus on client success
  • Motivated to learn

description:

A Snapshot of Your Day
Technical Support in electrical systems or equipment for SE customers. Focusing on maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization
Support internal teams in preparing proposals for sales, commissioning, modernization and expansion services for industrial or power Generation plants
How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Provide expert technical support for electrical systems, including troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance optimization in thermal power plants.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of electrical issues and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Collaborate with plant operators, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure safe, efficient electrical system operation.
  • Develop maintenance strategies, assist in system upgrades, and conduct training for plant personnel on electrical operations and safety.

What You Bring
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Power Engineering; advanced degrees/certifications in electrical systems are a plus.
  • Experience in electrical systems within thermal power plants, focusing on technical support and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical system design, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting, with proficiency in diagnostic tools (e.g., DIGSI).
  • Excellent communication skills, analytical abilities, and willingness to travel (50%-60%) for plant visits and training across Brazil, Argentina, and Latam.

About The Team
In this role, you will be part of a regional team supporting services for SE customers across LATAM, ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of thermal power plants. You will have access to both traditional and new technologies to optimize processes, while developing as a technical expert. You will provide both local and remote support to internal and external customers, working within an international company that offers opportunities for global growth and career advancement.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Company Description
Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ? We are Doctoralia , a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries , responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month! We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.
Our mission is to “make the healthcare experience more human.” Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.

As Team Leader of the Data Importation Department, you will play a crucial role in the company's operations, leading and developing the Data Migration Team. The management role focuses on KPI analysis, and creating tactical and operational plans while constantly seeking improvement and efficiency opportunities. It also involves collecting and analyzing feedback from the major stakeholders (Customer Success, Customer Care, Data Quality) to identify trends and areas for enhancement, always aligning local team practices with global standards.

What you will do in this role:

  • Manage and support the professional development of a team of 5 Data Importation Analysts;
  • Serve as the main point of contact for both Global & Local Structures regarding data migration;
  • Provide support to your team and clients by resolving data-import-related issues and offering assistance through designated communication channels;
  • Identify business challenges through data analysis while developing innovative solutions (through script development, for instance) to enhance operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and team productivity;
  • Ensure data security and confidentiality by implementing strict data security practices and policies within the team;
  • Contribute to the development of detailed internal documentation related to import processes.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • Higher Education in Data Processing or other IT-related fields;
  • Excellent English communication skills - there are daily interactions with our global partners;
  • Experience leading people - especially Customer Success or IT Support teams;
  • Advanced Excel and SQL skills;
  • Great analytical thinking skills and the ability to solve complex technical and business problems through data analysis and human relations;
  • Basic knowledge of programming languages like Python and R;
  • A sense of urgency and ownership to effectively address critical issues in a very fast-paced environment.

title: Banco de Talentos - Study Abroad Advisor (423779)
description:
PREP ESTUDAR FORA is a community-based program which aims to prepare talented Brazilian students for the application processes of the best universities abroad, at no cost whatsoever to the participants. Every year, we identify students through a rigorous, merit-based selection process to receive free guidance and preparation as they strive towards beginning their undergraduate education outside of Brazil. Participants receive an individual mentor who completed his undergraduate education abroad, virtual group orientation, nine hours of counseling with FUNDAÇÃO ESTUDAR’S professional college counselors and enrollment in an online preparation course comprised of detailed videos and homework assignments related to the application process. In addition, we offer need-based scholarships to help students cover the costs of the process (standardized tests, translations, a test preparation course, application fees, etc).

Student Counseling

  1. Advise a specific cohort of students on the college admission process by creating individualized plans and executing on them in collaboration with the student and student’s mentor.
  2. Continually research and expand a knowledge base with resources to support students in applying for college, including maintaining knowledge of high school curricula, college research, extracurricular and leadership choices, and standardized test planning to make recommendations regarding admissions strategies.
  3. Utilize in-depth knowledge of institutions of higher learning to guide students towards attainable school goals, working with them to create lists of best-fit schools of varied competition to maximize chances of acceptances and financial support.
  4. Guide students through the college essay writing processes, providing continuous feedback and personalized support.
  5. Provide assistance with standardized test planning and study tips (SAT/ACT and DET/TOEFL/IELTS).
  6. Lead student group training sessions and present as an expert speaker on external webinars.
  7. Maintain a high level of communication with your advisees through various channels (e.g. email, WhatsApp, etc.) and 1:1 advisement meetings.

Application Management & Student Support
  1. Oversee and manage projects related to the college admissions process for the entire program, including organizing and tracking student application deadlines and ensuring the quality completion of application requirements such as letters of recommendation, school profiles, and essays.
  2. Develop and implement program-wide support initiatives, such as workshops, presentations, and training sessions on topics such as application essay writing, college research, and financial aid.
  3. Monitor and analyze program data to assess effectiveness and make recommendations for improvement.
  4. Synergize with other areas of Fundação Estudar, to support the program’s students with other opportunities within the organization and to provide insight on study abroad trends.
  5. Maintain a high level of communication with program partners, such as high schools and universities, to ensure seamless collaboration and coordination.

title: Translation Project Coordinator
description:
Language Insight is a fast-growing translation and language services provider. Our experienced teams work on projects covering a wide range of sectors, and are dedicated to delivering high-quality translation, transcription, interpreting and various other language solutions to clients worldwide.

Language Insight is expanding our Project Management team in the Americas and is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Project Coordinator, who is pursuing to develop their career in the translation industry. The right candidate must be proactive, display a professional attitude, have the willingness to learn, and a desire to put clients first.

The position is remote and candidates will be based in Latin America to support our US team's working hours - 9am to 5:30pm EST (Monday to Friday). Some overtime after 5:30pm might be necessary on busy days/periods. We will be aiming to select the right candidate by the end of the year for a start in January 2025.

What does the role involve?

The Project Coordinator will primarily support our US clients, mainly across the Market Research sector, and will be responsible for handling multiple projects throughout their life cycle. This role will help ensure Language Insight remains one of the market leaders in the translation industry, enabling us to support clients across the world.

As this role will require autonomous working, Language Insight will provide a comprehensive training period of approximately 3-4 months (depending on individual progression) at the start of the contract. This training period will give the Project Coordinator an opportunity to develop their professional skills and equip them with the knowledge and tools needed for the position. During the training period, the candidate will be expected to work UK hours 0900 – 1730, so that they can be trained by our most experienced members of the team.

As part of the Project Coordinator role, you will:

  • Develop an understanding of the Translation and Market Research Industries.
  • Manage the full cycle of language services for our clients (from file prepping and quoting to delivering), ensuring that quality control measures have been adhered to.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, and linguists.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team to offer support and share ideas on best practices.
  • Support our US clients by providing excellent customer service through responsiveness and a consultative approach.
  • Manage and distribute the workload among internal and external linguists appropriately.
  • Ensure projects maintain a high level of quality and professional standards in line with our ISO 9001, 17100 and 27001 accreditations.
  • Ensure all admin is up-to-date at all times, and profit margins are healthy.
  • Learn how to use Translation Management Software and CAT tools to manage translation assets, such as glossaries, term bases, etc.
  • Support your UK colleagues by ensuring their projects continue to run smoothly after their working hours and provide them with complete handovers at the end of your shift.
  • Meet invoicing deadlines and quarterly targets.

What skills are needed for this role?

  • 1 year of experience working as a Project Manager in the Translation industry.
  • Experience in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Excellent written and oral communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • A desire to learn and contribute to efficiencies.
  • Exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to multi-task and work under pressure.
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills.
  • Ability to think outside the box and proactivity.
  • Ability to work in a team, as well as independently.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

Please note that this will be a contractor role but we are looking for a long-term collaboration and the successful candidate will be considered a full-time member of the Language Insight team.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.
Nossa Cultura
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
O Time De Fraudes
Nosso time tem como missão proteger os interesses da nossa companhia e de nossos clientes, garantindo a integridade e segurança das operações contra atividades fraudulentas. Buscamos identificar, analisar e mitigar os riscos de fraude em todas as áreas de atuação da organização e colaborar com outras instituições nessas descobertas, interceptando ações fraudulentas entre as as demais instituições, utilizando tecnologias avançadas, análise de dados e colaboração interdepartamental. Nosso objetivo é manter um ambiente seguro e confiável, preservando a reputação da nossa companhia e promovendo a confiança de nossos clientes e parceiros.
Como é Ser Um (a) Coordenador De Fraudes
Como coordenador de um time de prevenção a fraudes, você terá uma posição estratégica e desafiadora, com responsabilidades importantes, tais como:

  • Liderar e Coordenar uma equipe dedicada à Investigação e Repressão a fraudes. Isso inclui supervisionar as atividades diárias, definir metas, distribuir tarefas e garantir o bom desempenho da equipe;
  • Combate e prevenir atividades fraudulentas;
  • Tratamentos para os reportes de fraudes de Bandeiras e Instiruições;
  • Interações com órgãos das forças de segurança como: PM, PF e PC;
  • Participações em eventos relacionados ao Combate das fraudes em geral;
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias: desenvolver e implementar estratégias eficazes de prevenção a fraudes. Isso pode envolver a análise de dados para identificar padrões e tendências de fraude, bem como a criação de políticas e procedimentos para mitigar esses riscos;
  • Análise de dados: Uma parte crucial do trabalho será a análise de dados para identificar atividades suspeitas e potenciais casos de fraude. Isso inclui o uso de ferramentas analíticas e técnicas estatísticas para detectar anomalias e padrões suspeitos nas transações;
  • Interações com outras entidades, sejam públicas ou privadas, no intuito de combater as fraudes, caso necessários, diligencias em delegacias;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes dentro da organização, como Inteligência de dados, jurídico, atendimento ao cliente e financeiro. Isso pode envolver a troca de informações, compartilhamento de dados e coordenação de esforços para investigar e resolver casos de fraude;
  • Monitoramento contínuo: Além de identificar e investigar casos de fraude, monitorar continuamente as atividades e transações para detectar novos padrões de fraude e tomar medidas proativas para evitá-los.
O Que Esperamos De Você
  • Conhecimentos em editores de texto e planilhas (word, excel, google docs e google sheets);
  • Conhecimento em elaboração de apresentações (powerpoint, google apresentações);
  • Graduação em andamento em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou Direito.
O Que Aumentam Suas Chances
  • Conhecimento técnico: Experiência em análise de dados, ferramentas analíticas e técnicas estatísticas será essencial para o cargo.(SQL, EXCEL, PBI);
  • Habilidades de liderança: Capacidade de liderar e motivar uma equipe, bem como tomar decisões assertivas em situações de pressão;
  • Pensamento analítico: Capacidade de analisar grandes volumes de dados, identificar padrões e tendências e tomar decisões baseadas em evidências;
  • Experiência com gestão na área de Riscos e liderança será fundamental para esta vaga.

title: Consultor de treinamento
description:
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou em São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão, no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área de 30 mil m².

Em 2012, a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso padrão de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias, prontas para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-venda em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Consultor de Treinamentos, você irá:

  • Desenvolver, ministrar e acompanhar treinamentos técnicos sobre sistemas elétricos, hidráulicos e mecânicos de equipamentos da linha amarela para a frota SANY;
  • Elaborar material didático de suporte aos treinamentos;
  • Possuir conhecimento sobre frotas de linha amarela de médio e grande porte;
  • Entender o funcionamento dos sistemas hidráulico, elétrico, mecânico e do trem de força em equipamentos móveis;
  • Realizar análises de perfis de perdas e desenvolver procedimentos de melhoria para garantir a confiabilidade;
  • Monitorar a efetividade das práticas de manutenção e conduzir reciclagens de procedimentos técnicos;
  • Auxiliar na implementação de novas tecnologias e práticas nos equipamentos SANY;
  • Fazer interface entre operação e manutenção, avaliando as interferências do modo de operação na disponibilidade física dos equipamentos;
  • Participar do tratamento de incidentes, incluindo falhas operacionais e acidentes;
  • Identificar riscos relacionados à execução de atividades e propor medidas de controle adequadas;
  • Avaliar a segurança de manutenção, diagnóstico e reformas, identificando mudanças necessárias e propondo soluções cabíveis.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao time:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia (Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção, Eletromecânica ou Mineração);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Microsoft Office;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção e diagnóstico em equipamentos de linha amarela;
  • Experiência na aplicação de treinamentos teóricos e práticos;
  • Experiência anterior na instrução de equipamentos em mineração;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Vale Refeição
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

Customer Integration Specialist (Argentina)

Analyticalways es una empresa dinámica y en pleno crecimiento que ofrece soluciones inteligentes de planificación de inventario y gestión de existencias para la industria de Retail a nivel mundial. La inteligencia artificial y el aprendizaje automático han permitido a Analyticalways desarrollar la plataforma líder en el mercado para que las empresas brinden un ROI a través de una planificación y asignación de existencias más inteligentes para maximizar las ventas y la rentabilidad.

Como especialista en Integración trabajará en colaboración con los Consultores de Negocio y los equipos informáticos de los clientes para proporcionar la arquitectura del sistema y asesorar sobre la estrategia de despliegue. - Gestionará la relación con el cliente desde el punto de vista técnico para garantizar tanto el éxito de la implantación como la adopción por parte del cliente.

- Auditará la calidad y comprobará la coherencia del dato.

- Participará en reuniones (en persona y por conferencia) para los clientes asignados.

- Documentará y presentará arquitecturas a los equipos técnicos de los clientes.

- Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con todos los equipos de Analyticalways para garantizar el éxito de las integraciones de los clientes.

Requerimientos del perfil:

  • Experiencia en ETL y procesos de integración de datos.
  • Experiencia trabajando con SQL.
  • Conocimientos de Python, API y PowerBI son activos complementarios.

Se valorará:

Se ofrece:

Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes.   • Dar suporte técnico às equipes de execução, acompanhando a execução das atividades, visando o cumprimento das especificações técnicas e metas definidas.
  • Especificar equipamentos e componentes, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança vigentes, visando o atendimento às demandas da área.
  • Dar suporte técnico para a elaboração dos orçamentos da gerência, visando a correta distribuição e aplicação dos recursos, de acordo com os procedimentos internos.
  • Atuar na análise de falhas com foco na tratativa de anomalias, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e metodologias específicas, visando minimizar paradas indesejáveis.
  • Promover workshops, treinamentos técnicos, elaboração e revisão do Catálogo de Modos de Falhas dos Ativos e dos procedimentos e treinamento da área de Confiabilidade visando à capacitação da equipe para alinhamento e disseminação de conhecimento, atualização tecnológica e aplicação das melhores práticas.

Não apresenta a desenvoltura em todos os processos, operações ou equipamentos da sua área ou pleno nível de produtividade.
  • Atuar no apoio aos profissionais de maior senioridade nos processos inerentes à sua área de atuação usufruindo da experiência para o autodesenvolvimento.

A gente se encontra na C&A. Por aqui, acreditamos que nós podemos impactar positivamente as pessoas para que sejam o que desejam ser por meio da moda. Cada associada e associado traz consigo a alegria, a vibração e a energia para transformar o varejo e a moda no Brasil.

Somos muitos e únicos, cada um trabalhando para dar vida ao nosso propósito. Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes.

Nós vestimos as mudanças! Esse é o nosso DNA!

title: Faça sua Carreira de Engenharia de Processos no Itaú --
description:
Vem construir no Itaú

Como maior banco privado da América Latina, acompanhamos de perto o desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias e enxergamos o processo como uma evolução natural do nosso negócio, que torna possível termos um contato ainda mais próximo com a experiência de nossos clientes para continuarmos aprimorando suas jornadas.

Como é a área de Operações?

Ao longo de nossa história, desempenhamos um papel fundamental na estratégia do Itaú Unibanco . Dentro deste contexto, todos os produtos que oferecemos aos nossos clientes passam a ser produtos tecnológicos, independente da interface que ele escolha – seja ela física, digital ou mista. Vem construir soluções digitais em uma das maiores instituições financeiras da América Latina!

Como é a Carreira de Engenharia de Processos?

A Engenharia de processos no Itaú exerce um papel fundamental na busca constante da melhor jornada para nossos clientes, vem pra repensar o fundamental (ir na causa raiz das coisas), buscar a reestruturação radical dos processos que visam alcançar mudanças disruptivas em indicadores críticos de desempenho, tais como qualidade, custos, riscos e agilidade. A pessoa engenheira de processos pode estar alocada em Squads, em comunidades ou nas áreas do banco atuando sempre em projetos de transformação e melhoria contínua (Build e Run).


Como será o seu dia a dia?

  1. Garantir a aplicabilidade dos métodos para transformação das Jornadas fim a fim dos clientes.
  2. Priorizar as ações quantificando o impacto através de uma Engenharia de Valor, garantindo assertividade nas escolhas que agregam.
  3. Atuar no mapeamento de processos, resolução de problemas, construção e redesenho de jornadas, com foco no cliente, eficiência, qualidade e gestão de riscos.
  4. Desdobrar as dores dos clientes e conectar com elementos de processo.
  5. Realizar o estudo e a construção dos requisitos para os desenvolvimentos de tecnologia dos problemas assegurando o reuso de soluções.
  6. Desenvolver soluções em No/Low-Code para transformação dos processos. Garantir o teste funcional e homologação de requisitos de processos nas soluções desenvolvidas.
  7. Estruturar Gestão e Controle dos processos, aplicando ferramentas de qualidade, planejamento de demanda, intervenções operacionais, process mining, gestão da rotina, entre outras.

*Modelo de trabalho: híbrido de 8x presenciais no mês


Quais são as habilidades e competências necessárias?

Principais habilidades técnicas com experiência prática:

  1. LEAN
  2. Qualidade
  3. PCP (Planejamento e Controle de Produção)
  4. Gestão de Projetos/ Métodos Ágeis
  5. Análise e exploração de Dados
  6. Process Mining
  7. Método de Solução de Problemas

Formação em Engenharia de Produção é um diferencial.

O que esperamos de você:

  1. Habilidade em criticar de forma construtiva e provocativa;
  2. Habilidade em negociação e construção de parcerias;
  3. Capacidade analítica/ lógica;
  4. Habilidade em conectar conhecimento técnico com a estratégia dos projetos;
  5. Organização, disciplina e pró-atividade;
  6. Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa;
  7. Capacidade de tomada de decisões com base em processos e dados, foco no cliente e resultados.

A Cultura Ituber

O profissional de Quality Assurance, ou QA, é responsável por garantir a qualidade dos produtos ou serviços de uma empresa. No contexto de software, por exemplo, o QA testa softwares, aplicações, sistemas e sites para identificar e corrigir bugs, falhas e quaisquer outros problemas que possam comprometer a experiência do usuário final.

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias abrangentes de garantia de qualidade para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos do cliente e os padrões da indústria.
  • Criar planos de teste detalhados, casos de teste e scripts de automação para validar a funcionalidade, desempenho, segurança e usabilidade dos produtos.
  • Executar testes funcionais, de integração, de regressão e de aceitação do usuário para identificar e relatar defeitos, problemas de desempenho e áreas de melhoria.
